title: Chatting about sports without spoilers
objectives: Say that you missed the final and ask whether it was good

courseTemplate.setting: The learner missed the match and will watch the replay at lunch. The partner can describe the excitement without revealing the score.

roles.learner: A coworker who plans to watch a replay
roles.partner: A coworker excited about a football final

courseTemplate.openingLine: Did you catch the final last night?

targetPatterns.pattern: I missed it. Was it a good match?
targetPatterns.example: I missed it. Was it a good match?

targetPatterns.pattern: Please don't tell me the score. I'm watching the replay at lunch.
targetPatterns.example: Please don't tell me the score. I'm watching the replay at lunch.

targetPatterns.pattern: Thanks! Let's talk about it after I've watched it.
targetPatterns.example: Thanks! Let's talk about it after I've watched it.

targetPatterns.pattern: Have you seen the new season yet?
targetPatterns.example: Have you seen the new season yet?

targetPatterns.pattern: What are you streaming these days?
targetPatterns.example: What are you streaming these days?

targetPatterns.pattern: What kind of music do you listen to?
targetPatterns.example: What kind of music do you listen to?

targetPatterns.pattern: I binge-watched the whole season in two days.
targetPatterns.example: I binge-watched the whole season in two days.

targetPatterns.pattern: Is that show worth the hype?
targetPatterns.example: Is that show worth the hype?
targetPatterns.translation: 那部剧配得上这么多吹捧吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Let's watch the game together this weekend.
targetPatterns.example: Let's watch the game together this weekend.

stages.title: Say that you missed the final and ask whether it was good
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Did you catch the final last night?”
successCriteria: The learner can say that you missed the final and ask whether it was good in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I missed it. Was …”

stages.title: Ask politely to avoid spoilers
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “It was really close. Do you want to know the score?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask politely to avoid spoilers in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Please don't tell me …”

stages.title: Suggest a later conversation
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “No problem. I won't say a word.”
successCriteria: The learner can suggest a later conversation in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Thanks! Let's talk about …”

languageNotes: 「追剧」是 follow a show / binge-watch，不说 "chase the drama"；聊体育先问对方支持哪队（Who do you root for?）再站队。

warmup.prompt: Say this in English. 你看新一季了吗？
warmup.suggestedAnswer: Have you seen the new season yet?

Thanks! Let's talk about it after I've watched it.
